citations.claim: The API client package exports CentaurClient and related types as the main public interface
CentaurClient is the primary HTTP client class using axios with authentication and timeout configuration
The streamEvents method provides real-time event streaming using Server-Sent Events with async generators
The normalizeHarnessEvent function is the main dispatcher that handles three harness types: codex, pi-mono, and amp
Comprehensive TypeScript type definitions for content blocks and canonical events across the system
Thread key management utilities for parsing channel:timestamp format identifiers
Final delivery system uses polling with lease-based processing for reliable message delivery
Slack integration service instantiates CentaurHandoff for workflow management
API client depends on axios for HTTP communication and eventsource-parser for SSE streaming
Slackbot service uses comprehensive dependencies including OpenTelemetry for observability and Slack APIs
The spawn method creates new agent threads with configurable harness and persona options
The execute method triggers agent execution with platform and delivery options
Workflow management includes starting, monitoring, and controlling workflow runs
Final delivery claim mechanism supports batched processing with lease management
CentaurHandoff service posts workflow runs to the Centaur API using fetch with authentication headers
